segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are mixed: several report no irritation, redness, or breakouts and note the scent is mild or absent, but at least two report a reaction — small bumps or irritation — tied to fragrance in some of the mask varieties.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who describes her skin as dry (also mature, age 57) reports the masks left her skin very soft and hydrated, keeping her face moisturized through the next morning.
segments.mature: A 57-year-old reviewer with dry, mature skin reports the masks left her face soft and hydrated overnight and calls them good value for the price.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers report visible firming or a reduction in the look of fine lines and wrinkles after use, in one case describing fine wrinkles as filled in and less noticeable overnight.
concerns.dehydration: Hydration is the most consistently reported benefit, with reviewers describing plump, soft, moisturized skin after use and effects lasting into the next morning; one reviewer cautions that hyaluronic acid can pull moisture from the skin if the skin or environment is already dry.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report no redness or irritation, including one who specifically notes the absence of the reddening that sometimes occurs with collagen products, and one with sensitive, redness-prone skin reports the masks helped calm her redness considerably.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers are divided on fragrance: several with sensitive skin report no reaction and appreciate a mild or absent scent, but at least two report irritation or small bumps from the fragrance in some of the mask varieties.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers report the masks do not trigger breakouts, including one who says these are the first sheet masks that haven't left her with a morning breakout; one sensitive-skin reviewer with adult acne reports improved skin texture after use.

extraits.texte: These masks are not for people who have sensitive skin, because they contain fragrance. If your skin is sensitive, these masks may give you tiny little bumps on your face as a reaction. I removed the mask before it got worse. I love the value for the price, but I hate the fact that they contain fragrance.

These collagen hydrogel masks are, in my opinion, pretty standard. I've tried better, I've tried worse. They come in two pieces, which is definitely helpful when you're trying to get a good fit for your face, but I still had to make some rips and cuts to make it lay flat in several areas (but I think that's pretty standard with these types of masks, as we all have unique facial structure). The pieces are fairly fragile and will rip if you don't handle them carefully. They're soaked in a generous amount of serum, with a puddle of it left in the packaging that you can pat onto your neck or your face after you remove the mask (but it's VERY sticky, so your face will stay tacky for quite some time if you do so). I kept the mask on for several hours, until it started detaching around my mouth and chin from me eating. I wish I could sleep in these types of masks, but I just can't manage to, I find it too uncomfortable. When I removed the mask, my face felt very soft and hydrated. It didn't leave my skin with the glow that some other brands do, but those brands are also typically pricier, so it's understandable. My face stayed feeling moisturized all night and still felt nice the next morning. I feel like it made my night products last longer because my face was more hydrated (for reference, I'm 57 and have dry, mature skin). extraits.titre: Plump and hydrated after my first mask!
extraits.texte: This hydrogel mask left my skin feeling incredibly soft, hydrated, and plump after the first use. My face felt smooth to the touch and looked noticeably refreshed once I removed it. I didn't experience any redness or irritation. The mask is unscented. The box includes four individually wrapped masks, and each packet has its own instructions printed directly on it. The directions are provided in both Korean and English and include simple illustrations that make the process easy to follow. Each mask is divided into a top and bottom section, which makes it easier to fit different face shapes and sizes. Each hydrogel piece is sandwiched between two clear plastic layers that keep it saturated in serum. There is no front or back to worry about. Just peel off the plastic layers and place the hydrogel directly onto your face. One thing I really like is that the instructions suggest applying your own serums first on a clean dry face before placing the mask on top. I used four of my own serums and then applied the mask. This makes the mask very customizable depending on what your skin needs that day. Because my face is small, the top and bottom sections overlapped slightly. If you move around a lot the mask can shift a little and may need to be slid back into place. I also would not recommend eating or drinking unless you are using a straw because the mouth opening is intentionally small so it covers the delicate skin around the lips. I have pretty sensitive skin - adult acne, redness, lots of texture. It’s a constant fight to find products that work for me and don’t irritate my skin further. I was hesitant to buy these masks because of the low cost, but I was leaving for a work trip and wanted something to find to soothe my skin after flying. I cannot express how much I love these masks. I’ve tried all of them, and they leave my skin feeling so soft, essentially eliminated texture overnight, and helped my redness a ton. I will definitely be repurchasing over and over. I don’t use them every night, but rather 2-3 times a week. Couldn’t recommend more.

I’m not exaggerating when I say that these are the best sheet masks I have ever used. I love the variety, and they are the first ones that don’t make me wake up with a breakout in the morning. My only gripe is I wish there was no fragrance added, but the smell is very mild and pleasant and like I said it doesn’t cause any irritation. Leaves my skin looking beautiful. Very affordable considering how many you get. Very minor stickiness after mask is removed, each one makes my skin feel plump and hydrated. So great for a self-care evening.

extraits.titre: Good Results With This Hydrogel Mask
extraits.texte: These Nextbeau Collagen Hydrogel Face Masks arrived as a pack of four individually wrapped masks. Each mask consists of two pieces and each piece is contained between sheets of plastic. I found them easy to put on with no tearing, they fit the skin well, were appropriately sized and have a nice thickness. I found that they started to go transparent on my forehead after about an hour and I left it on for another hour when it was starting to dry out. My skin felt very soft afterwards, I had no reddening of my skin which sometimes happens with collagen products but not with this mask. There's a little slick feeling to my skin as the layers of the mask lock in hydration. Overall I'm very satisfied with this mask and its effectiveness in creating a smoother skin tone and bright appearance.

These are very good set of face masks. It comes in a pack of 4 and I really like that they come individually packaged which means using one doesn't mean you're affecting the other 3, which some other similar products who use an all in one packaging does. The hydrogel masks feel pretty dense out of the pack and you can definitely feel its properly soaked in serum. It's not soaking wet that it drips everywhere but I did notice some product left over on the packaging and I feel this is a positive note considering you really want the mask to not be dry before using it. The mask is made of 2 different pieces. Applying is pretty simple although if you have a smaller face, some parts might require some more time manipulating the shapes but as the masks are quite wet, it makes it easier for them to stay on and they are able to stick to your face pretty good even if you're walking around. You're supposed to keep them on until the opaqueness turns into clear, which I think is pretty cool as you can have a visual indicator to know that there's something going on. Upon removing, my skin felt really hydrated and I feel it does a good job firming the skin and reducing fine wrinkles. Overall a very satisfactory pack of masks that's worth the price.
